verdicts.reason: A: the FIZZBANG! pill runs almost the full canvas width with only about 4px of margin, so it feels jammed against the edges. The SINCE 2026 badge is nearly as wide and heavy as the pill, which weakens the hierarchy, though the group sits near the vertical centre. B: the pill has proper side margins and the smaller badge is clearly subordinate, but the group sits low (around 55–80% of the height), leaving the top half as empty halftone. B is still closer to the original's lower-centre placement and spacing. Neither one rearranges the layout for the tall format; both just scale the pair down.
